scholarships.title: University of Porto Scholarships and Funding (SASUP, Merit and Scientific Scholarships)

existing.description: The University of Porto promotes and sponsors financial support for its students and researchers. The three schemes named on the official page are SASUP study scholarships, awarded as a monthly cash payment by the Social Support Services of the University of Porto; U.Porto Merit Scholarships, a cash prize for students with the best academic results; and Scientific Scholarships, research scholarships for undergraduate and postgraduate students. Awards are cash-based; the official page does not describe any tuition-fee waiver, and the only tuition-linked item is the first-year Incentive Prize, which is stated to be equivalent to the annual tuition fees.
eligibility: Enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's or Integrated Master's programme at U.Porto (SASUP study scholarship)
Portuguese or European Union national, stateless person, or national of a country with a cooperation protocol providing reciprocal application of the benefit
Students with the International Student Status are explicitly excluded from SASUP scholarships
Merit scholarships: enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's or Integrated Master's programme at U.Porto and displaying exceptional academic achievement, 'regardless of their socio-economic situation'
Scientific scholarships: enrolled in undergraduate research, Bachelor's, Master's or Doctoral study
existing.eligibility_summary: SASUP study scholarships are for students enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's or Integrated Master's programme at U.Porto who are Portuguese or EU nationals, stateless persons, or nationals of countries with cooperation protocols providing reciprocal application of the benefit; students with International Student Status are excluded. Merit scholarships are awarded on academic results regardless of socio-economic situation.
benefits: SASUP Social Support Fund (FAS) emergency allowances for students not covered by the scholarship system
Collaborators' Grant for part-time participation in university activities
coverage: Monthly cash payment intended to contribute to costs of attending the course (SASUP study scholarship)
Cash prize for academic merit (U.Porto Merit Scholarships)
Incentive prizes to the best first-year students of each of the 14 schools/faculties, 'equivalent to the amount of the annual tuition fees'
Annual research scholarships for undergraduate, Bachelor's, Master's and Doctoral students
requirements: Meet the prerequisites of the intended course, where applicable
documents: Applicants are ranked according to their final grade for the respective Higher Professional Technical Diploma (HPTD) and their score in the admission tests.
application_method: SASUP study scholarships are applied for through the Portuguese DGES BeOn platform (https://www.dges.gov.pt/wwwbeon/)
Deadlines and application results are published on the SASUP website (https://www.sas.up.pt/)
SASUP lists the admitted and not admitted candidates on its website, after which the applicant's Organic Unit contacts the applicant
existing.best_fit: Outstanding international students at University of Porto
existing.duration: SASUP study scholarship is granted and renewed annually; scientific scholarships 'as a rule' run annually and are extendable up to three years.
existing.application_period: Annually; SASUP states 'the scholarship is granted and renewed annually, with deadlines and application results published on the SASUP website'.
existing.deadline_display: Deadlines and application results vary by scheme and are published on the SASUP website; the U.Porto portal page states no calendar date.
existing.program_type: University internal scholarship and financial support portfolio (study, merit and scientific scholarships)
